title: Lewis Black at Epstein's mansion and the Israeli defense minister

tellings.quote:
Lewis Black's story is so interesting.
He walks in the door. There's a marker
board where they go in and there's all
it looks like football plays or
something.

plain: The comedian Lewis Black once walked into the New York mansion of Jeffrey Epstein, a wealthy financier, and found a marker board by the door covered in what looked like football plays. The story, as it is known, also involves Israel's defense minister. Fellow comedian Kurt Metzger retells it to Michels as "so interesting" and also names the comedian Bobby Slayton in connection with it, as a strange glimpse of who and what moved through Epstein's house.
